name: gateway-dingtalk
description: Outbound-only DingTalk (DingDing / 钉钉) robot gateway. send POSTs a text or markdown message to a custom robot webhook URL with optional HMAC-SHA256 sign.

credentials.name: dingtalk_webhook_url
credentials.description: DingTalk custom-robot webhook URL (https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=...). Override with env COS_DINGTALK_WEBHOOK_URL.

credentials.name: dingtalk_secret
credentials.description: Optional shared secret for HMAC-SHA256 sign mode. When present, every request is signed with timestamp + secret. Override with env COS_DINGTALK_SECRET.
